summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth where current compliance checks pass and existing disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Block changes for sites with failed compliance controls until remediated. Current compliance baseline is 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 checked sites; open findings include banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms controls. Analytics is unavailable for all 38 expected sites and remains unknown, not zero. Recommendation: permit bounded compliant growth, keep private or parked properties unchanged, and do not treat this review as legal certification.

Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only. Public beta, Woot-derived public display, alerts, affiliate or advertising use, rights outreach, and launch changes are blocked pending authoritative permission, human counsel review, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public collection and derivative use. Do not send outreach or change the gate.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 open. Existing evidence is partial for source rights, data flow, and consent; no task may be closed without direct evidence. Smallest next action: produce and attach the read-only data-flow and retention table from repository and deployed configuration, covering alert rules, identifiers, sync results, Slack/email delivery, retention, deletion, correction, access, and unsubscribe behavior. Continue read-only work only.

Concrete launch decision for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net: keep parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence to the existing readiness packet.

The proposed allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is conditionally permissible as bounded reversible growth after capacity release, provided it preserves existing destinations, registered tracking, disclosures, product relevance, and data collection, with accessibility and link validation. No revenue, ROI, conversion, or causal-lift claim is supported. The MarkItDown concept remains research-only and conditional on owner-approved fixtures, source rights, disposable artifacts, and later security and quality review; no external ingestion, production adoption, or deployment is cleared.
